wedding.introText: Two families, one celebration. With full hearts we invite you to share the day we promise each other forever — your laughter, blessings and company would make it complete.

items.title: Wedding Ceremony
items.description: We say our vows in the rose garden, surrounded by the people we love.

items.title: Garden Cocktails
items.description: Sparkling drinks and small bites on the terrace by the fountain.

items.title: Candlelight Dinner
items.description: A long-table dinner under chandeliers in the château hall.

items.title: Dance Under the Stars
items.description: Cake, a live band and dancing in the courtyard until late.

venue.name: Château de Lumière
venue.address: Route des Vignes, Loire Valley, France

dressCode.text: Dress to celebrate — formal evening wear in soft, romantic tones that suit a summer garden wedding.

registry.title: Gifts
registry.description: Your presence is the only gift we ask for. If you would still like to give something, a contribution towards our first home together would mean a great deal to us.
